episode_title: Novogradac 2026 OZ Conference: Biggest Crowd Since 2019 (Episode 400)

real_qa.q: What was the attendance at the 2026 Novogradac Opportunity Zones Conference compared to previous years?
real_qa.r: The 2026 Novogradac Opportunity Zones Conference had the biggest crowd since 2019, with fantastic attendance that exceeded expectations. The record turnout reflects extremely high interest in the Opportunity Zones incentive, particularly because the program now has permanency after originally expiring.

real_qa.q: What is the November 23rd deadline for Opportunity Zones regulations?
real_qa.r: The due date for comment letters on Treasury Department proposed regulations and notices regarding the Opportunity Zones incentive is November 23rd. The Novogradac Opportunity Zones Working Group is focused on preparing comprehensive commentary in response to Treasury's requests.

real_qa.q: What is the significance of January 4th, 2027 for new Opportunity Zones funds?
real_qa.r: January 4th, 2027 is the first business day of the year and the key date when new Opportunity Zones funds are expected to launch. Many funds are currently firing up and raising capital in preparation for launching early in 2027, with considerable consulting work underway to prepare PPMs and begin capital raising efforts.

real_qa.q: How much capital was raised in Opportunity Zones during Q3 according to Novogradac's latest survey?
real_qa.r: Novogradac's unreleased third quarter results show that almost $800 million was raised in Opportunity Zones during Q3. This occurs during what Jason Watkins describes as a dead period where primarily only investors with running 180-day clocks are still investing before the new year.
real_qa.requete: Novogradac Q3 Opportunity Zones capital raised

real_qa.q: What was the total Opportunity Zones investment through year-end 2024 according to Treasury?
real_qa.r: According to a Treasury working paper from a few months back, the total Opportunity Zones investment through year-end 2024 was approximately $100 billion. Novogradac's survey tracks about one-third of that universe, with their tracked amount being almost exactly one-third of Treasury's reported total.

guest.titre_secondaire: Chairman of the Novogradac Opportunity Zones Working Group
guest.bio_context: Jason Watkins has been working in the Opportunity Zones space since 2018. He leads the Novogradac Opportunity Zones Working Group and chairs the annual Novogradac Opportunity Zones Conference. He conducts quarterly surveys of qualified opportunity funds tracking capital raised in the OZ space and advises clients on year-end compliance and fund formation strategy.
